text:
maya: Hey folks — planning to move from Brooklyn (NYC) to Jersey City (NJ) at the end of the month. Quick Qs: how does this affect my WFH stipend proration, health plan network, commuter/pre-tax transit benefits, and state tax withholdings? Do I need to update homebase now to avoid payroll snafus? cc @people-ops

sam: Congrats on the move! Short answers: update homebase, yes to payroll changes, stipend is prorated for partial months. We can walk through exact steps. :tada:

alex-payroll: Hi Maya — from payroll side: if we get your updated address before the payroll cutoff we can change state withholding for the next pay run. Cutoff for the next pay is 2026-04-24 23:59 PT. NJ will require NJ withholding; NY residency rules can be more complex if you keep a NYC address. If you want to update now, use: https://redwood.internal/payroll/address-change (secure form).

maya: I use the commuter pre-tax benefit for MetroCard reloads. Will moving to JC immediately cancel that?

lina-benefits: Commuter benefits: our commuter vendor supports NY and a few adjacent options but not NJ in all cases. If your commute shifts to PATH/Light Rail and you no longer qualify for NYC MetroCard, we can pause the MetroCard election and explore a transit reimbursement option, but that may require change requests and carrier processing. Health plan: plan enrollment remains the same but provider networks differ — run your zip through the insurer lookup after you update homebase.

sam: WFH stipend specifics: policy ties the monthly stipend to your declared homebase city. Move mid-month -> prorated. If you move before the payroll cutoff we typically prorate that month on the next paycheck. If you move after cutoff we can process a retro proration in the following cycle but need approval. To request proration, reply with: PRORATE + move date.

maya: Move date is 2026-04-28. I plan to close old lease on 4/27. Will that be OK?

alex-payroll: That should be OK but you need to submit address-change by 2026-04-24 to get NJ withholding live for the May payroll. If you miss that window we'll update for the following pay period and make any retro adjustments. Also attach a proof-of-address if you want us to change benefits/census now. Note: you may need to file a state withholding certificate for NJ — link in form.

people-ops-bot: Action items (we'll follow up in a ticket):
- maya: submit address-change form + proof-of-address by 2026-04-24.
- maya: reply with "PRORATE 2026-04-28" if you want WFH stipend proration applied.
- alex-payroll: check payroll cutoff and schedule withholding change.
- lina-benefits: assess commuter eligibility and health-network impacts for JC zip.

maya: Thanks — doing the form now. Two tiny asks: can benefits team confirm whether my primary care doctor is in network for the new zip, and if commuter pause can keep my balance until I return?

lina-benefits: Send me your doctor's name and the new zipcode in DM and I'll check quickly. Commuter balance: we can pause deductions; vendor rules determine whether stored MetroCard value carries over. We'll flag this as "pause" not cancel while we investigate.

sam: One more payroll note: if you retain any NY residency ties (own property, file as NYC resident) we may need payroll/tax counsel to avoid dual withholding issues. If that sounds relevant say so and we'll loop in tax.

maya: No property, just closing lease. I'll submit form + proof today and reply PRORATE 2026-04-28. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
